title: Grace reaches first
summary: Let mercy and grace reach the heart before effort strains. Keep this close: Keep this in front of you: ask for the mercy that turns nearness into tasted sweetness.
takeaway: Return to the gift before turning it into a review.
lifeApplication: When shame starts taking over the room, pause and let grace reach the heart before you explain yourself.

source.shortMeaning: Grace meets the soul before worthiness is proven.
source.lifeApplication: Before auditing yourself again, receive one line as mercy and answer from there.
